**How does it work?

You will need a stand, such as a glass, a jar, a box, or you can purchase one that suits your needs. I recommend some on my website, calcaapp.com.

**Select an image.

You can do this from your camera, search for one on the internet, take a screenshot or select one you already have on your device. It can be a photo, a drawing, a text, a sketch, as long as it is an image file.

Then, you will go to the tracing area, where you must give permission to your device's camera to be able to see through it and the selected image the area where you are going to draw. Hence the 'projector' effect. You can adjust the opacity by means of a sliding bar at the bottom, until you get the most comfortable result to start tracing. The zoom and rotation of the image can be controlled with your fingers. In addition, the camera zoom can be adjusted via a slider bar at the bottom. You will also be able to use a grid, which I have found to be a better option than cropping the image, as many devices were causing errors. **Note:** There is an option where the camera, image and grid are modified together with your fingers. Its rotation should be avoided, as when the whole camera is rotated, the movements of the stylus, hand, etc., do not match those seen on the device. Therefore, there is an option to lock the rotation, although it may be an adventure to try.

**Note:** Your device MUST FOCUS ON THE DRAWING AREA, be it paper, wall, floor, etc., FOR PROPER FUNCTIONING, AVOID PASSING YOUR HAND BETWEEN THE DRAWING AREA AND THE DEVICE.
